selection: Two terminal intervals: archived historical failed withdrawal and the independently recorded positive agent payout. Selected after reading published values, before fresh interval responses; not a blind test.
alreadyCollected: Original failed-withdrawal before block header replaces one new header read. Status confirmed chain_id=testnet.
methods: query:view_state with empty prefix, no pagination/proof
excluded: No call_function or view_code fetch/execute; no keys, credentials, signed payload, transaction submission, account changes, mainnet, paid endpoint or load/performance test.
goal: Corroborate endpoint fields and receipt outcomes through our own raw query captures, separately from producer summaries. Source/schema inspection is static. Public-node consistency is not cryptographic state proof or independent grading.
